title: Yellow Zone Final Hardening - Implement Missing Functionality
repo_context: Implement remaining yellow-zone gaps: tombstone stats/compaction and robust model identity tracking

stories.title: Add tombstone statistics API to PersistentVectorStore
acceptance_criteria: PersistentVectorStore has get_stats() method returning dict with active_chunks, total_vectors, tombstoned_count, tombstone_ratio
get_stats() queries metadata store for accurate counts
Test validates stats accuracy after insertions, updates, and deletions
Stats include pool_identifier for context
stories.notes: Point 7 - need visibility into tombstone accumulation before we can compact

stories.title: Implement compact() method to rebuild index without tombstones
acceptance_criteria: PersistentVectorStore has compact() method that rebuilds HNSW index from metadata
Compaction preserves all active chunk_ids and vectors, discards tombstones
Label mapping is rebuilt (old labels → new sequential labels)
Metadata store is updated with new label mappings
Test validates: index works after compaction, tombstone_count = 0, all active chunks still retrievable
Compaction is safe (no data loss)
stories.notes: Point 7 - implement the actual compaction logic to clean up tombstones

stories.title: Add should_compact() helper and document compaction strategy
acceptance_criteria: PersistentVectorStore has should_compact(threshold=0.3) method returning bool
Returns True when tombstone_ratio > threshold (default 30%)
Add docstring documenting compaction strategy: when to compact, why, operational impact
Update agents.md with 'Tombstone Compaction' section documenting: what tombstones are, when to compact, how to trigger manually
Test validates threshold logic
stories.notes: Point 7 - provide clear guidance on when/why to compact

stories.title: Add model fingerprint tracking to manifest for robust staleness detection
acceptance_criteria: SemanticIndexManifest includes embedding_model_fingerprint field (hash of model weights or version)
Builder computes fingerprint from embedding provider and writes to manifest
Lane staleness check compares fingerprints, not just friendly names
Staleness detection differentiates: model name changed vs model weights changed
Test validates: fingerprint mismatch detected even if friendly name matches
stories.notes: Point 4 - robust model identity to prevent false positives/negatives in staleness detection

stories.title: Validate all 10 yellow-zone points are complete with comprehensive tests
acceptance_criteria: All semantic lane tests pass (pytest backend/retrieval/lanes/semantic/ -v)
Create VALIDATION.md documenting all 10 points with status COMPLETE and evidence
Each point includes: what was implemented, file paths, test names
No regressions in existing functionality
Stats API shows correct tombstone counts
Compaction works and removes tombstones
Fingerprint tracking prevents false staleness
stories.notes: Final verification that all yellow zone points are truly solved and production-ready
